verified_facts.text: Raffles Seychelles opened on the island of Praslin in 2011 and was the first Raffles resort.
verified_facts.excerpt: Opening its doors on the island of Praslin in 2011, Raffles Seychelles was the first Raffles resort

verified_facts.text: It is an all-villa resort where every villa has a private pool, set on hillsides and beachfront on Praslin Island.
verified_facts.excerpt: our 87 spacious private pool villas cascade down the verdant hillsides of Praslin Island

verified_facts.text: The resort is in a UNESCO area with a tropical hillside and beachfront setting.
verified_facts.excerpt: an all-villa retreat in a UNESCO area occupying a tropical hillside and beachfront setting of rare natural beauty

verified_facts.text: Villas come with a private Raffles Butler.
verified_facts.excerpt: with food prepared by your private Raffles Butler

verified_facts.text: The Two Bedroom Beachfront Pool Villa is a brief stroll from Anse Takamaka beach.
verified_facts.excerpt: From this two-bedroom villa it's a brief stroll to the caster-sugar sands of Anse Takamaka beach.

verified_facts.text: Most visitors fly into Seychelles International Airport on Mahe and continue to Praslin by domestic flight, high-speed ferry, yacht or private helicopter to the resort's own helipad.
verified_facts.excerpt: Most visitors fly into Seychelles International Airport (SEZ) on Mahé Island, and travel on to Praslin via domestic flight, high-speed ferry, luxury yacht or private helicopter to our own helipad.

verified_facts.text: Private flights from Mahe reach the resort's own helipad in 15 minutes.
verified_facts.excerpt: Private flights from Mahé, delivering you to the resort’s own helipad in just 15 minutes.

verified_facts.text: Giant Aldabra rescue tortoises live in the resort's grounds, and guests can meet and feed them.
verified_facts.excerpt: Meet and feed the 16 adult and three young giant Aldabra rescue tortoises, who now live in our grounds.

verified_facts.text: The fitness centre is TechnoGym-equipped, with a double infinity pool and long beach walks.
verified_facts.excerpt: Enhanced facilities and personal training in our TechnoGym equipped centre, with a double infinity pool and long beach walks for optimum fitness.

verified_facts.text: Complimentary activities for toddlers, children and teenagers run all day every day.
verified_facts.excerpt: A flourish of fun, complimentary activities for toddlers, children and teenagers, all day every day.

verified_facts.text: Yoga sessions, group or private, include ashtanga, hatha, pranayama, prenatal and children's yoga, plus meditation.
verified_facts.excerpt: Join a group or private session to practise ashtanga, hatha, pranayama, prenatal or children's yoga, and meditation.

verified_facts.text: The resort has had a total ban on single-use plastic since 2019.
verified_facts.excerpt: enabling us to implement a total ban on single-use plastic since 2019

verified_facts.text: The resort works with the Marine Conservation Society on a coral rehabilitation project, with a snorkelling trail to its coral nurseries.
verified_facts.excerpt: we collaborate with the Marine Conservation Society on a coral rehabilitation project, creating a snorkelling trail for guests to discover our newly-constructed coral nurseries

verified_facts.text: Boat excursions leave directly from the resort's beach on Anse Takamaka.
verified_facts.excerpt: From our calm location on Anse Takamaka, you can embark on a boat excursion directly from our beach.

verified_facts.text: The resort offers boat-based fun dives for certified divers plus PADI Discover Scuba Diving experiences and courses.
verified_facts.excerpt: At Raffles Seychelles, we offer boat-based fun dives for certified divers as well as PADI Discover Scuba Diving experiences and courses.

verified_facts.text: Scenic helicopter flights leave from the resort's private helipad.
verified_facts.excerpt: These are the wonders that wait for those who sign up for our scenic flights, offered via helicopter from our own private helipad.

verified_facts.text: Creole cooking classes take place in an open-air beach kitchen.
verified_facts.excerpt: Head for our open-air beach kitchen to discover the stories behind the piquant flavours of Creole cuisine.

verified_facts.text: The Sunset Escapade takes guests by car to Anse Lazio beach for champagne and canapes served by their private butler.
verified_facts.excerpt: We'll transport you directly to the white sands of Anse Lazio at the north-western edge of Praslin.

verified_facts.text: The resort's culinary and social spaces are being transformed, with work scheduled to continue until 15 October 2026 and alternative dining locations in place.
verified_facts.excerpt: Raffles Seychelles is currently undergoing a comprehensive transformation of our culinary and social spaces, scheduled to continue until 15th October, 2026.

verified_facts.text: Some renovation work is visible around the property.
verified_facts.excerpt: Some renovation work is visible around the property; however, all projects have been carefully planned to ensure guests are not disturbed by noise or undue disruption.
